lines.1: --Friday at the end of the week.
lines.2: Sure enough, Konoe was sitting on the bench after cram school.
lines.3: But something was different from usual.
lines.5: She was eating bread with a blissful expression.
lines.6: 「You look like you are in a good mood.」
lines.7: 「You really do just come over and start talking to me now.」
lines.8: 「Your habits have gotten kind of interesting to me.」
lines.9: 「Am I some exhibit!? The way you put that gets on my nerves.」
lines.10: 「Your anger does not have its usual punch.」
lines.14: 「I eat bread loaded with my favorite peanut butter.」
lines.15: She really was eating it like it was the best thing in the world.
lines.21: Konoe tore into the bread like even talking to me was a waste of precious time.
lines.22: Something about it was squirrel-like and oddly endearing.
lines.23: 「Well, if you are happy, I will leave you to it. Later.」
lines.25: This side of her was interesting because it was so different from her painfully serious behavior at school.
lines.27: For some reason, she got angry. Why?
lines.28: Come to think of it, trouble with other schools had been dying down lately. Things were peaceful.
lines.29: I had even ended up attending cram school seriously.
lines.30: It was almost a little boring.
